Criteria.TestCondition: The user can pause, stop, hide, or control the frequency of automatically updating content.
DisabilityImpact: With Limited Language, Cognitive, and Learning Abilities
Criteria.TesterComment: We could not finish this test, so a person needs to check it. The content "56" stops while a control has focus, which may be a pause-on-focus rather than a real pause. A person should check that the control itself pauses it. We also saw signs of other updates that we did not see keep changing: it asks its server for new data about every 1.1 s; it sets a timer of 30 s, longer than we watched.

Criteria.TestCondition: The page provides notification of each automatic update/change in content.
DisabilityImpact: With Limited Language, Cognitive, and Learning Abilities
Criteria.TesterComment: The content "56" changes by itself, but screen reader users are not told: it is not in a live region, focus does not move to it, and no dialog appears. Put it in an aria-live region, or let users pause it and announce the change.

Criteria.TestCondition: All functionality can be accessed and executed using only the keyboard.
Criteria.TesterComment: This test is not finished yet: 1 question about it is still open. The page has an embedded frame we could not read that we cannot check automatically; please check it works with the keyboard. "Country:" (list) works with a mouse but can't be reached with the keyboard; a question about it is still open. We looked for: things a mouse can click that the keyboard never reaches, including inside frames; menus that open when the mouse rests on them; custom controls that ignore Enter and Space; and tooltips with information found nowhere else. Results are for the browser used (version 153.0.8010.12).

Criteria.TestCondition: A visible indication of focus is provided when focus is on the interface component.
DisabilityImpact: With Limited Language, Cognitive, and Learning Abilities
Criteria.TesterComment: Some elements don't show when they have keyboard focus, so keyboard users can lose track of where they are. We could not get a clear before-and-after view of "International Space Station Trajectory Data" (link) (scrolled out of view before the next step), so a person needs to check whether it shows focus: load the page and press Tab 13 times. We could not get a clear before-and-after view of "Learn More about Frequently Asked Questions" (link) (images could not be compared (ValueError)), so a person needs to check whether it shows focus: load the page and press Tab 19 times. We could not get a clear before-and-after view of "#post-856825 > div > div:nth-of-type(9) > div > div > fig..." (link) (scrolled out of view before the next step), so a person needs to check whether it shows focus: load the page and press Tab 20 times. We could not get a clear before-and-after view of "Learn More about International Space Station" (link) (never in view), so a person needs to check whether it shows focus: load the page and press Tab 21 times. We could not get a clear before-and-after view of "The top third shows part of the space station in focus. T..." (link) (scrolled out of view before the next step), so a person needs to check whether it shows focus: load the page and press Tab 22 times. When "Hide player controls" (button) gets focus, nothing on or around it changes that we could see, so keyboard users can't tell focus is there. To see it, load the page and press Tab 28 times. If you can see a focus indicator we missed, tell your assistant. We could not get a clear before-and-after view of "NASA Johnson" (link) (its focus style draws an outline or a shadow that our pictures did not show where it is), so a person needs to check whether it shows focus: load the page and press Shift+Tab 41 times. When "Hide player controls" (button) gets focus, nothing on or around it changes that we could see, so keyboard users can't tell focus is there. To see it, load the page and press Shift+Tab 43 times. If you can see a focus indicator we missed, tell your assistant. 68 other element(s) showed focus clearly.
